opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 504 U. S. 908.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that Carter G. Phillips, Esq., of Washington, D. C., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent Guy W. Olano, Jr., in this case. Motion of the Solicitor General to permit William K. Kelley, Esq., to present oral argument pro hac vice granted.
